lines.beaver: 오늘 공연 어땠어요? 신인 배우가 많았죠.
lines.beaver_en: How was today's show? There were many new actors.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul gongyeon eottaesseoyo? sinin baeuga manatjyo.
lines.learner: 네, 특히 악역을 맡은 신인이 인상 깊었어요.
lines.en: Yes, the newcomer who played the villain impressed me most.
lines.roman: ne, teuki agyeogeul mateun sinini insang gipeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: He stood out even in a supporting role. How was his acting?
lines.en: I felt sincerity more than technique, so I watched breathlessly.

lines.beaver_en: What did you think of the singing scene?
lines.learner: 유행가를 부를 때 박자가 아주 정확했어요.
lines.en: His beat was very precise when he sang the pop song.
lines.roman: yuhaenggareul bureul ttae bakjjaga aju jeonghwakaesseoyo.

lines.learner: 동작에 조형미가 있어서 흡사 그림 같았어요.
lines.en: His movements had beauty of form, just like a painting.
lines.roman: dongjage johyeongmiga isseoseo heupsa geurim gatasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The mural behind the stage was nice too, right?
lines.en: Yes, I heard it's a creative work by a famous artist.

lines.beaver_en: There was a comedy scene in the middle, too.
lines.learner: 관객이 일제히 웃어서 대중성도 있어 보였어요.
lines.en: The audience laughed all at once, so it seemed to have mass appeal.
lines.roman: gwangaegi iljjehi useoseo daejungsseongdo isseo boyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was the final lullaby scene?
lines.learner: 조용한 장면이라 떨리는 목소리가 더 아쉬웠어요.
lines.en: It was a quiet scene, so his shaky voice was more of a pity.
lines.roman: joyonghan jangmyeonira tteollineun moksoriga deo aswiwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you're giving a lot of praise.
lines.en: It's not praise; I merely said what I saw.

lines.beaver_en: They say this work will be entered in a theater festival.
lines.en: I can only hope for a good result.

lines.beaver_en: Will you go see his next work too?
lines.learner: 물론이죠. 그 신인 배우를 계속 응원할래요.
lines.en: Of course. I'll keep cheering for that new actor.
lines.roman: mullonijyo. geu sinin baeureul gyesok eungwonhallaeyo.
